checks.name: database_v1_to_v3_migration
checks.result: Encrypted task and audit history were preserved, a stable job ID was assigned, and a legacy active journal record was re-queued.

checks.name: checkpoint_resume_after_process_crash
checks.interruptionMethod: Android ActivityManager VM crash injection against the isolated validation package
checks.result: Persisted JobScheduler work resumed at step 1, completed from the encrypted note checkpoint without rereading the provider, and the process-local capability grant was absent after restart.

checks.name: authorized_execution_and_wait_for_user_resume
checks.result: Authorized local execution saved both steps; missing authorization moved the task to waiting_for_user and wrote a denial audit; a fresh grant allowed resume to completion.

checks.name: pause_resume_cancel_after_checkpoint_with_pending_job
checks.result: After step 1 was committed, pausing removed the pending persisted job and the task stayed paused beyond its minimum latency with the checkpoint intact and no step 2 audit. Resuming completed step 2 without another capability invocation. Cancelling a second checkpointed task removed its pending job; it remained cancelled without a result or success audit.

checks.name: active_worker_pause_resume_cancel_after_checkpoint
checks.result: A test-only gate held the actual JobService executor thread after the first encrypted checkpoint committed. Pause and cancel both stopped the worker before step 2; resuming the paused task completed from that checkpoint without a second capability call. No cancellation result or success audit was written.
